entities.name: Mandek Ironfist
entities.description: Warlord of the Darkling Plains of Golthonor on Corondor who founded the Iron Kingdom.

entities.name: Golthonor
entities.description: Land of the Darkling Plains on Corondor.

entities.name: Xarl
entities.description: Archmage who aided the summoning of Trine and became Angel-Keeper.

entities.name: Trine
entities.description: Serra Angel summoned by Skule and enslaved.

entities.name: Skule
entities.description: Wizard who summoned the Serra Angel Trine.

entities.name: Enslavement of Trine
entities.description: 326 dark years of Trine's enslavement in which countless lives were lost on Corondor.

entities.name: Gan
entities.description: People killed on Mandek's order along with their Golthan army.

events.summary: With Xarl's aid Skule summons Trine and Mandek sacrifices his nephew to her, beginning the Enslavement of Trine.
events.quote: Mandek was forced to sacrifice his nephew to Trine

events.summary: Mandek orders Trine to kill the people of Gan and their Golthan army.
events.quote: Mandek ordered her to kill the people of Gan and their Golthan army

events.summary: After Xarl becomes the Angel-Keeper, Mandek founds the Iron Kingdom.
